  • Tue 13

    Calvin Arsenia

    October 13 @ 8:00 pm

    Ten years ago, Calvin Arsenia premiered Catastrophe at recordBar on Grand Boulevard, introducing Kansas City to a theatrical concert vocabulary that would become central to his work: harp, voice, movement, spectacle, storytelling, and a cast of collaborators large enough to make a concert feel more like a small civilization. Since then, Arsenia has become one of Kansas City’s most singular musical figures, voted Kansas City’s Best Musician by The Pitch for eight consecutive years, 2018–2025, while receiving recognition and support from organizations including the Charlotte Street Foundation, ArtsKC, and the Mid-America Arts Alliance. His work has moved between concert halls, fashion runways, theaters, recordings, and film, including the feature-length Summer in Hindsight, for which he contributed original music and performance.

    On Tuesday, October 13, 2026, Arsenia returns to the historic Folly Theater with a seasoned gathering of beloved Kansas City musicians for an evening that looks across a decade of songwriting. Familiar songs will sit alongside new arrangements, offering a portrait of an artist whose work has continued to evolve without losing its appetite for beauty, theater, intimacy, and transcendence. A curated VIP experience will provide an additional, more intimate entry into the evening. Ten years after Catastrophe, the Darling Harpist comes home to the stage that Kansas City built for its most extravagant little secrets.

    $25 – $75
  • Fri 16

    Furia Tanguera

    October 16 @ 7:30 pm

    Furia Tanguera takes you on a theatrical experience that combines the strength and elegance of Argentine tango with the passion and excitement of folklore traditions. In this multidisciplinary show, the dancers and singers unite under the rhythm of tango and folk music and live percussive dance. Accompany the artists from nostalgia to euphoria as the all-star cast of Argentine artists weaves traditional storytelling through a modern setting. Watch the fury of tango come alive!

    $25 – $65
  • Sat 17

    Good Trouble

    October 17 @ 7:00 pm

    Inspired by the Justice Choir and Singing Resistance movements, OUTside Voices KC presents Good Trouble bringing local choral ensembles together in a powerful celebration of music as a force for justice and change. Through songs of resistance, resilience, and hope, voices rise together—reminding us of the extraordinary power we hold when we sing as one. At the heart of this inspiring experience is acclaimed vocal activist Melanie DeMore, an accomplished singer-songwriter, composer, and choral conductor whose artistry transforms collective singing into a call for courage, connection, and action.

    $20 – $30

    Steve Taylor & Some Band

  • Fri 30

    5th Annual Concert for a Cause

    October 30 @ 7:00 pm

    This concert is a fundraising event celebrating our mission to expand opportunities for students while honoring the enduring legacy of Dr. George Washington Carver.

    Established in 1943, the George Washington Carver Birthplace Association (CBA) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to education and community enrichment. One of our key initiatives is awarding annual scholarships to high school seniors pursuing higher education in the fields of Agriculture, Art, Education, Music, or Science.
